title: REQ · Zustand dependency and drawer and modal state with actions
summary: useUiStore exposes drawerOpen and modal state with toggle, open and close actions.
description: Context: no store exists. Desired behavior: useUiStore holds drawerOpen (default false) and activeModal (null | 'contribution' | 'settings') with toggleDrawer, setDrawerOpen, openModal and closeModal. Expected result: importable store. Why: drawer and contribution modal need shared state.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fresh store, When read, Then drawerOpen is false and activeModal is null
Given a fresh store, When toggleDrawer is called twice, Then drawerOpen is true then false
Given a fresh store, When openModal('contribution') then closeModal() are called, Then activeModal is 'contribution' then null
technical_constraints: Use zustand create with typed state interface
